touhou_little_maid_tweaks.sleep_config.e: Default 22:30 gives maids time to pathfind to beds after bedtime. Manual and automatic maid-only skips wait until this time; player assistance keeps normal timing.

touhou_little_maid_tweaks.work_config.no: Join a world to view or change its maid work rules.
touhou_little_maid_tweaks.work_config.wo: Work rules for this world. Save applies changes immediately.
touhou_little_maid_tweaks.work_config.se: Work rules for this server. Operators can save changes.
touhou_little_maid_tweaks.work_config.re: Only the world host or server operators can change these rules.
touhou_little_maid_tweaks.work_config.av: Let work take priority over leisure seats

Maids may sit in vacant chairs when resting, jobless or out of work. A maid needing a seat for work can take over from an unlocked leisure occupant. Seated maids leave when actual work requires movement, when their scheduled activity changes, or at bedtime. Locked maids stay seated until you unlock them.
touhou_little_maid_tweaks.work_config.lo: Seat a maid, then turn off her Allowed to sit switch to keep her seated. Disabling this rule releases locked seats and restores normal dismounting.
touhou_little_maid_tweaks.work_config.an: Use weighted density, adult-pair protection and optional breeding limits for TLM and Farm & Cook animal work. Overrides their native animal-count caps. Off restores each mod’s native behavior and pauses stations and milk.
touhou_little_maid_tweaks.work_config.st: Enable shared pen management. Requires adjusted breeding and slaughter. Off makes stations decorative: no menu, animal management or milk. Saved pen settings are retained.
touhou_little_maid_tweaks.work_config.mi: A verified pen with a live adult cow supplies unlimited milk buckets. Requires animal stations. Off clears the milk display and stops collection.
touhou_little_maid_tweaks.work_config.to: Replace broken tools with identical spares
Move a spare of the exact same item from the maid backpack into the slot after a tool breaks, retaining its components.
touhou_little_maid_tweaks.work_config.de: These defaults apply to maids without saved animal-job overrides. Each maid’s gear tab and each shared pen keep their own saved policies.
touhou_little_maid_tweaks.work_config.wi: Side length of the regular square animal search, from 2 to 64 blocks.

touhou_little_maid_tweaks.work_config.li: Only feed below the selected limit. Off allows unlimited breeding.
touhou_little_maid_tweaks.work_config.pr: Keep at least two adults of each animal type. Babies are never slaughter targets.
